basic_details.short_information: Maj Dhyan Chand Sports University (MDSU), Meerut has invited applications from eligible officers for two posts of Coach (Athletics) on deputation basis, at Pay Level-10 (₹56,100 – 1,77,500). Applications, forwarded through proper channel, must be addressed to The Registrar at Modipuram, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh – 250110, and must be received by 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM. The advertisement is dated 13 November 2026.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Maj Dhyan Chand Sports University, Meerut
Any one of four qualifications in Athletics coaching or sporting achievement (see below); open to eligible serving officers only
Post, through proper channel; advance copy may be emailed

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: Maj Dhyan Chand Sports University is located at Salawa, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh. The notice describes it as established by the Government of Uttar Pradesh and the first sports university of Uttar Pradesh. The Coach will train the university's students and athletes for university, state, national and international competitions.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the university website, www.sportsuniup.com . Send the application through proper channel, duly forwarded by the cadre controlling authority / parent department, with the documents listed under Enclosures. Address it to: The Registrar, Maj Dhyan Chand Sports University, C/O College of Technology, Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel University of Agriculture & Technology, Modipuram, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh – 250110. Write "Application for the post of Coach (Athletics – Running / Jumping / Throws) on Deputation" on the envelope. An advance copy may be sent by email to [email protected] . It will be considered only if the application through proper channel is received within 14 days of the last date. The notice does not name a postal mode such as speed post or registered post. Applications received after the last date, without the required documents or not through proper channel will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Officers working under the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territory Administrations (including their attached or subordinate offices), Public Sector Undertakings, autonomous or statutory bodies, universities, or recognised educational / research institutions, who meet any one of these: Hold an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or Have 3 years' regular service in posts in Pay Level-7 (₹44,900 – 1,42,400) or equivalent in the parent cadre or department; or Have 8 years' regular service in posts in Pay Level-6 (₹35,400 – 1,12,400) or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. Diploma or equivalent in Coaching (Athletics) from SAI NSNIS Patiala, or from any other recognised Indian / foreign university; or Medal winner in Athletics at the Olympic Games / World Championships, or twice Olympic participant; or Participation in Athletics at the Olympic Games / Paralympic Games / recognised international events while representing India; or Dronacharya Awardee (Athletics). Experience (desirable): at least 10 years of coaching experience in Athletics, in the sub-discipline for which the candidate applies. Age limit: not exceeding 55 years on the last date of receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Eligibility and terms follow the norms of the Sports Authority of India (SAI) for deputation of coaches. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.post: Coach (Athletics), for any one sub-discipline of Running / Jumping / Throws

rows.events_covered: Sprints, hurdles, relays, middle and long distance, race walking
High jump, long jump, triple jump, pole vault
Shot put, discus throw, javelin throw, hammer throw

content_sections.heading: MDSU Coach (Athletics) Job Description
content_sections.text: Train the university's students and athletes for university, state, national and international competitions. Work as per the training schedule fixed by the university, including mornings, evenings, weekends and holidays. Accompany teams to competitions and camps.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Certificate in the prescribed format (Part J of the application form), signed by the forwarding authority. Attested photocopies of the Annual Performance Appraisal Reports (APARs) for the last 5 years. Vigilance clearance and integrity certificate. Statement of major / minor penalties imposed, if any, during the last 10 years. No Objection Certificate from the parent department. Self-attested copies of certificates of qualification, coaching experience and sports achievements. The application form has a space for a recent self-attested passport-size photograph. It also asks for the sub-discipline and main events, the eligibility criterion claimed, present employment, qualifications, service and coaching experience, achievements as an athlete and as a coach, and a declaration by the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be through scrutiny of applications followed by an interview and/or a practical coaching demonstration. The university may shortlist candidates on criteria higher than the minimum prescribed. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by email/phone and on the university website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview or demonstration.

faq.question: Q1. How many Coach (Athletics) posts is MDSU filling?
faq.answer: The post table in the MDSU notice shows 02 (Two) posts of Coach (Athletics) on deputation, for any one sub-discipline of Running, Jumping or Throws.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MDSU Coach (Athletics)?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 27 November 2026, 5:00 PM. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the MDSU Coach (Athletics) post?
faq.answer: Only officers of the Central Government, State Governments, UT Administrations, PSUs, autonomous or statutory bodies, universities or recognised educational / research institutions who meet the stated service conditions. They must also have one of the four listed qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for MDSU Coach (Athletics)?
faq.answer: Any one of: a Diploma or equivalent in Coaching (Athletics) from SAI NSNIS Patiala or another recognised Indian / foreign university; Olympic Games / World Championships medal or twice Olympic participation; participation for India in Athletics at Olympic / Paralympic Games / recognised international events; or Dronacharya Awardee (Athletics).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MDSU Coach (Athletics)?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 55 years on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. What is the pay for MDSU Coach (Athletics)?
faq.answer: The post carries Level-10 of the 7th CPC pay matrix, ₹56,100 – 1,77,500. Pay, leave, pension, provident fund and other conditions are governed by the rules of the parent department and the standard terms of deputation.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MDSU Coach (Athletics)?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.sportsuniup.com and send it through proper channel, forwarded by the parent department, to The Registrar, Modipuram, Meerut – 250110. Write the prescribed wording on the envelope and enclose the listed documents.

faq.question: Q8. Can I email my application to MDSU?
faq.answer: An advance copy may be emailed to [email protected]. It will be considered only if the application through proper channel is received within 14 days of the last date.

faq.question: Q9. How will MDSU select the Coach (Athletics)?
faq.answer: Selection is through scrutiny of applications followed by an interview and/or a practical coaching demonstration. No TA/DA is paid for attending it.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the deputation period?
faq.answer: The deputation is initially for 3 years, extendable up to 5 years as per rules, or till the officer attains 60 years of age, whichever is earlier.
